enemies.name: Grunt
enemies.blurb: Fires aimed 3-shot spreads.

enemies.name: Burster
enemies.blurb: Fires rings of bullets; more in each ring on later waves.

enemies.name: Sniper
enemies.blurb: Fast, accurate shots from far away.

enemies.name: Spinner
enemies.blurb: Wanders and sprays spirals in bursts; it spins up while bursting.

enemies.name: The Warden
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 5): a prison riot in three stages — searchlight, gates and gas, then rioters.

enemies.name: Charger
enemies.blurb: Flashes a red line, then dashes along it and bursts into a ring.

enemies.name: Splitter
enemies.blurb: Splits into 3 fast Shards when killed.

enemies.name: Shard
enemies.blurb: Tiny and fast. Comes from Splitters, Nests and the Hive Queen.

enemies.name: Mortar
enemies.blurb: Lobs bombs at where you stand; they burst into a ring on landing.

enemies.name: Shielder
enemies.blurb: A front shield blocks shots and swings. It turns slowly: flank it.

enemies.name: Medic
enemies.blurb: Heals nearby enemies every few seconds. Kill it first.

enemies.name: Hive Queen
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 10): a hive in three stages — drones and bombers, sealing cells and honey, then a frenzied swarm.

enemies.name: Reaper of Dusk
enemies.blurb: Boss pair (wave 15): a tether sweep, then they fuse into the Dual Reaper (pillars, holes), then split for a finale.

enemies.name: The Singularity
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 20): corner gravity wells, pull, lasers and shrinking cages.

enemies.name: Phantom
enemies.blurb: Flickers, blinks next to you and bursts into a ring.

enemies.name: Hexer
enemies.blurb: Fires curving pincer shots that close in from both sides.

enemies.name: Juggernaut
enemies.blurb: Armored and slow, can't be slowed or knocked back. Rotating stars of orbs.

enemies.name: Nest
enemies.blurb: Stationary spawner that keeps hatching Shards until destroyed.

enemies.name: The Colossus
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 25): huge stomp rings with one gap, and thrown rocks.

enemies.name: The Duelist
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 30): teleports and leaves decoys that burst unless killed.

enemies.name: The Lich
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 35): immune while its phylactery stands; raises skeletons.

enemies.name: Storm Herald
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 40), three stages: a gathering storm (strikes, lightning rods), a gale that pushes you and bends bullets, then a supercell that marks one player at a time.

enemies.name: The Devourer
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 45), three stages: hungry for morsels (your shots heal it), then swallowing players, then a mouth that heals it from the front.

enemies.name: The Eclipse
enemies.blurb: Final boss (wave 50), five stages and Totality: a sun and its moon. Hide in the moon's shadow from the flash, stay in the light, and kill it before the nova.

enemies.name: Spiker
enemies.blurb: Small and fast melee rusher with long thin spikes. It zig-zags toward you in pairs.

enemies.name: Brute
enemies.blurb: Slow, tough melee bruiser that hits hard (24) when it reaches you.

enemies.name: Lunger
enemies.blurb: Circles in close, flashes a pink line, then leaps along it.

enemies.name: Beam Sentry
enemies.blurb: Plants itself, aims a line at you, then sweeps a beam across your side.

enemies.name: Scorcher
enemies.blurb: Circles you leaving a trail of embers. Cut across before it closes.

enemies.name: Reaver
enemies.blurb: Armoured melee: a red cone, then a rake. Open for a moment after: +50% damage.

enemies.name: Warder
enemies.blurb: Puts bubbles on up to three allies. Kill it and they all pop.

enemies.name: Pauser
enemies.blurb: Fans out shots that stop dead, glow, then all rush at where you are. Keep moving.

enemies.name: Leader
enemies.blurb: Aims where you're going, not where you are. Change direction when it fires.

enemies.name: Stitcher
enemies.blurb: Fires slow orbs; nearby orbs are tied by a harmful thread. Slip through the gaps.

enemies.name: Riot Shield
enemies.blurb: A guard behind a tall shield that bashes you back. Go round it, or break the shield: then it falls fast.

enemies.name: Gas Grenadier
enemies.blurb: Lobs tear-gas canisters at you. Step out of the cloud.

enemies.name: The Gatekeeper
enemies.blurb: Challenge room mini-boss: a ring of shots with a gap, three aimed fans, and a charge along a shown line that ends in a burst.

enemies.name: Shadow
enemies.blurb: Mirror Match: a dark copy of a player, with their class and their way of fighting. It sidesteps every few seconds.

enemies.name: Shambler
enemies.blurb: Zombie: a wide, slow lurcher that hits hard. Don't get cornered.

enemies.name: Runner
enemies.blurb: Zombie: frail but faster than you walk, in packs of three. Turn and shoot.

enemies.name: Spitter
enemies.blurb: Zombie: hangs back and lobs globs that leave burning, slowing acid. Keep moving.

enemies.name: Crawler
enemies.blurb: Zombie: scuttles low and grabs you, rooting you in place. Shoot it to break free.

enemies.name: Bloater
enemies.blurb: Zombie: swollen and slow; it bursts into a slowing spore cloud. Pop it at range.

enemies.name: Shrieker
enemies.blurb: Zombie: hangs back and screams, sending the horde round it into a frenzy. Silence it.

enemies.name: Mender
enemies.blurb: Zombie: heals the horde round it and makes the dead rise faster. Kill it first.

enemies.name: Buzzsaw
enemies.blurb: A fast ring of spinning spikes that swoops round on curves. Each touch is small, but they come about eight times a second.

enemies.name: Spike Block
enemies.blurb: Rocks from side to side as it closes in, then stops, flashes a red line and lunges for a big hit (35). Slow to recover.

enemies.name: Swarmer
enemies.blurb: The simplest melee rusher: a white chomper with no eyes that walks straight at you. Weak alone, and it comes in packs.

enemies.name: Fuse Runner
enemies.blurb: A powder keg on the run: it plants its feet near you and blows up after a 0.8 s fuse, hurting enemies too. Step out, or shoot it early.

enemies.name: Hookman
enemies.blurb: Throws a harpoon along a blinking line and yanks you to its squad. Sidestep or parry; a miss leaves it open (+50%).

enemies.name: Sapper
enemies.blurb: Plants tripwire pods; armed pods are joined by lasers. Cross a laser or step on a pod and it blows. Shoot a pod to use it on enemies.

enemies.name: Tripwire Pod
enemies.blurb: A Sapper's pod: arms in 1 s, then a laser joins it to armed pods near it. Shoot it to blow it up.

enemies.name: Swordsman
enemies.blurb: Walks up, raises a long sword and cuts the cone drawn on the floor in front of it. Step out of the cone, then hit it while it recovers.

enemies.name: Shield Swordsman
enemies.blurb: A Swordsman behind a shield that stops every shot from the front. The shield drops when it cuts and stays down while it recovers: shoot it then, or from the side.

enemies.name: Taser Guard
enemies.blurb: Keeps its distance, charges its taser and fires a white Fork Bolt that stuns you. Dodge the bolt, or parry it.

enemies.name: Security Guard
enemies.blurb: Locks on where you're heading, then fires one tracer round at a time: seven shots, then a long reload. Change direction in the red lane, or rush it while it reloads.

squads.name: Dead march
squads.members: Shambler x6, Mender x2, Runner x3
